## Standard Pre-Configured BODAS-service CAN ID : {#standard-pre-configured-bodas-service-can-id .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

According to ISO 15765-2,

 Physical Request CAN ID     : 0x18DA\<TA\>FA

 Physical Response CAN ID   : 0x18DAFA\<TA\>

 Functional Request CAN ID  : 0x18DBFFFA        

TA  - Target address is the ECU node ID. Default TA is pre-configured as 0x01 and can be re-configured from easyConfig and also using the API  bds_uds_updNodeIDinNVM().

SA  - Source Address is the tester ID. 0xFA is reserved by Bosch Rexroth for tester tool BODAS-service.

Note: Only \<TA\> can be configured from easyConfig.
